# Lunoviq Studio

> Spreadsheets (Excel and Google Sheets) for UK landlords, letting agents, sole traders and cleaning businesses. Instant download on Etsy: https://www.etsy.com/shop/LunoviqStudio

## Spreadsheets

- [UK Landlord Spreadsheet 2026/27](https://tolgaoy5-cpu.github.io/lunoviqstudio/products/uk-landlord-spreadsheet.html): Rent, arrears, compliance, SA105 tax and Making Tax Digital for UK landlords, in one Excel and Google Sheets workbook. Made for: Private landlords with 1 to 100 properties in the UK, including HMO owners and landlords who manage lets for family. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/uk/listing/4565879627/uk-landlord-property-management-system
- [UK Rent Arrears Tracker](https://tolgaoy5-cpu.github.io/lunoviqstudio/products/uk-rent-arrears-tracker.html): See who owes rent, how much and for how long. Rent is charged for you, arrears are aged, the Ground 8 level is checked and arrears letters are written. Made for: UK landlords, HMO owners and small letting agents who want one clear list of who owes what. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/uk/listing/4604263089/uk-rent-arrears-tracker-landlord
- [UK Property Certificate Tracker](https://tolgaoy5-cpu.github.io/lunoviqstudio/products/uk-property-certificate-tracker.html): Keep every landlord certificate in date: gas safety, EICR, EPC, fire, licences and more, for every flat, shop and block. Made for: Landlords, block managers and letting agents with residential lets, HMOs, common parts, shops or mixed-use buildings. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/uk/listing/4605732323/uk-property-certificate-tracker-landlord
- [AI Certificate Reader for Google Sheets](https://tolgaoy5-cpu.github.io/lunoviqstudio/products/ai-certificate-reader.html): Drop a certificate PDF and the tracker reads it and fills in the row: property, certificate type, dates, result, company and certificate number. Made for: Letting agents and landlords with many properties who receive certificates as PDFs or photos and are tired of typing them in. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/uk/listing/4605754518/ai-certificate-reader-uk-landlord
- [UK Mileage Log Spreadsheet 2026/27](https://tolgaoy5-cpu.github.io/lunoviqstudio/products/uk-mileage-log.html): Log business trips at HMRC's 55p rate and let the spreadsheet work out your mileage claim for the 2026/27 tax year. Made for: Sole traders, landlords and employees who use their own car, van, motorbike or bicycle for work. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/uk/listing/4604282412/uk-mileage-log-spreadsheet-202627-hmrc
- [UK Sole Trader Spreadsheet 2026/27](https://tolgaoy5-cpu.github.io/lunoviqstudio/products/uk-sole-trader-spreadsheet.html): Invoices, expenses, mileage, income tax, National Insurance, VAT and Making Tax Digital for self-employed people in the UK. Made for: Sole traders and freelancers in the UK who file a Self Assessment return. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/uk/listing/4566703343/uk-sole-trader-bookkeeping-spreadsheet
- [Cleaning Business Spreadsheet](https://tolgaoy5-cpu.github.io/lunoviqstudio/products/cleaning-business-spreadsheet.html): Leads, clients, jobs, quotes, invoices, payments and real job profit for cleaning businesses, in Excel and Google Sheets. Made for: Self-employed cleaners and small cleaning companies: domestic, commercial, Airbnb turnover and end of tenancy. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/uk/listing/4567277315/cleaning-business-spreadsheet-client-crm

## Guides

- [Making Tax Digital for landlords: what changed in April 2026](https://tolgaoy5-cpu.github.io/lunoviqstudio/guides/making-tax-digital-for-landlords-2026.html): Who must use Making Tax Digital for Income Tax, the £50,000, £30,000 and £20,000 thresholds, the quarterly update deadlines and what records to keep.
- [HMRC mileage rates 2026/27: 55p a mile explained](https://tolgaoy5-cpu.github.io/lunoviqstudio/guides/hmrc-mileage-rates-2026-27.html): The approved mileage rates from 6 April 2026: 55p for cars and vans, 25p after 10,000 miles, 24p for motorcycles and 20p for bicycles, and who can claim them.
- [Rent arrears and Ground 8 after 1 May 2026 (England)](https://tolgaoy5-cpu.github.io/lunoviqstudio/guides/rent-arrears-ground-8-renters-rights-act.html): How the Renters' Rights Act changed Ground 8: the new 3 months or 13 weeks arrears level, the 4-week notice, Universal Credit delays and how to keep records.
- [Landlord certificates checklist: how often each one is due](https://tolgaoy5-cpu.github.io/lunoviqstudio/guides/landlord-certificates-checklist.html): Gas safety every 12 months, EICR every 5 years, EPC every 10 years, smoke and CO alarms and the other checks UK landlords track, with what to give tenants.
